title: [PC, Steam] Pax Autocratica $8.39 @ Steam
body:
Deal: [PC, Steam] Pax Autocratica $8.39 @ Steam

[MHLoppy] It would be funny if this was intentional 5D chess publicity / making buyers feel like they're getting a killer deal.
[Kommodore] Meh I still dont want it at 80% off looks like a generic unity engine effects overload early access slop that is good for 2hrs then 8 years for them to finish game.
The other game they made looks even worse and was abandoned.
And people are doing the Helldivers thing and fanboying facism on the forums lol, no thanks.
[MHLoppy] 92% positive across 2k reviews is pretty good, a lot better than "generic unity engine effects overload early access slop" would imply.
[Kommodore] Look at the reviews for their only other game, tons of people saying they abandoned it, shut down servers, false advertising of stuff that isn't in game, the other reviews say it is greatest game ever made. You trust that studio to finish this game and deliver on everything?
[MHLoppy] @Kommodore:
You trust that studio to finish this game and deliver on everything?
I don't necessarily, but most of the recent reviews are saying this game is already fun, so it's not a deal-breaker.
[GunnerMcDagget] Did anyone read the Terms and Conditions? I just want to make sure that my oppressive regime tactics aren't going to be used by the current US government.
[dbell] The discount is actually a price error from the developer. They were going 20% not 80% lol.
